segments.en:
This is the Terra Realm,
the Gaia Continent.

Most of this continent has fallen
to the invasion of the mighty
Grados Army.

But the resistance groups fighting
back were slowly growing in
strength.

A faction is seeking
an alliance.
It will be shown with a marker.

Alliance formed with the Resistance.
The Resistance joins your forces.

Alliance formed with the
Grados Army.

Entering combat with the
Grados Army.

You can now dock at
Grados City.

Entering combat with the
Resistance's main force.

You can now dock at the
Resistance Base.

Entering combat with the
Redros-Galfa forces.

The enemy forces have been
driven off.
The Cusco gate can now be used.
